notes.title: Hotfix v 1.2.0
notes.content: [p]We’re bringing you an update with improvements and fixes to make your workouts smoother and more enjoyable: [/p][list][*][p]Offline Mode: Sessions in offline mode now appear correctly.,[/p][/*][*][p]DLCs: Fixed an issue that prevented cosmetics from DLCs purchased outside the game from showing up properly.,[/p][/*][*][p]Infinite Loading Screen: We’ve addressed a recurring issue that caused infinite loading screens for many users. While we can’t guarantee it’s 100% resolved for everyone, our tests indicate it should no longer occur.,[/p][/*][*][p]Several visual bugs have been fixed to improve the overall look of the game.,[/p][/*][*][p]UI Adjustments: Fixes to the menu, including the button to open/close dojos.,[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual improvements for a more polished experience.[/p][/*][/list]
